$comment: Input for `node scripts/zephyr.mjs create --spec <path>`. Copy to src/evidence/<TICKET>/zephyr-spec.json. Write this from the SEAM TABLE, before any Playwright spec exists — the cases are the design, not a transcript of the code.
$stepsConvention: Numbered USER actions, one discrete action per step. expectedResult belongs on the case (applied to the last step) and names one observable outcome. Never write framework internals — getByRole, afterEach, file paths — into a step: a manual tester reads these next release.
cycleDescription: Planned cases for the PROJ-123 checkout regression. Executions recorded after the evidence run.

tests.name: Verify a completed order confirms back to the shopper
steps: Log in to the storefront as a standard shopper
Add a product to the cart
Open the cart and select Checkout
Enter first name, last name and postcode, then select Continue
Select Finish on the order overview
tests.expectedResult: The order confirmation is displayed and the cart badge returns to empty.

tests.name: Verify checkout refuses to continue without a postcode
steps: Log in to the storefront as a standard shopper
Add a product to the cart and select Checkout
Enter first name and last name, leave the postcode empty
tests.expectedResult: Validation reads "Error: Postal Code is required" and the order overview does not open.
